pages.title: The research scope remains broader
pages.text:
The research scope remains broader
GFuNK learns graph-spectral nonlinear generators and integrates trajectories across
speciﬁed geometry and diﬀusion families.
The three-gain companion is a ﬁxed-time
baseline, not that architecture.
